verification.method: scripts/verify/rankings-104.py reads the original World Bank zips and API metadata (data/raw/wdi/) and the UN WPP 2024 file, not the site's generated data; then the text was read by hand
verification.what: every ranking row (132 economies, order and value), the CSV, every figure in the text, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD; claims: top seven order, India above $100 billion first in 2022, share-of-GDP top three, top-ten share, growth since 2000, Ethiopia not ranked; definition and data-quality caveats taken from the World Bank indicator notes
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and indicator metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0); UN WPP 2024
verification.result: All 1,042 automated comparisons across the three pages matched; one claim corrected before publishing (world median inflation in 2022 was the highest since 2008, not since 2000)

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026) for 2025.
Added a world map of the ranking (Natural Earth outlines, same World Bank figures as the table) and country flags in the table.
